articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Is It Too Late To Consider S&P Global (SPGI) After Strong Multi‑Year Share Gains?. If you are wondering whether S&P Global's share price lines up with its underlying worth, you are not alone. This article walks through what that might look like using several valuation tools. The stock last closed at US$541.94, with returns of 5.7% over the past week, 10.3% over the last month, 5.7% year to date, 13.1% over one year, 51.6% over three years and 84.7% over five years, which naturally raises questions about how much value is already reflected in the price.
